paragraphs: Zonar Systems sells fleet management technology aimed at safety and efficiency. The stated customers are small to mid-sized businesses, enterprise fleets and public sector organizations across the Americas. Fleet segments called out include state and local fleets.

A ridership product shows when and where riders get on and off. In-cab cameras use AI to detect and capture specific safety events inside and outside the cab. Electronic inspection results upload to a dashboard where authorized staff review them online. Vehicle and asset locations are visible online in real time. Its logging device is self-certified with the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration to meet U.S. ELD regulations. It is also third-party certified with Transport Canada.
Vehicle health checks are pitched as a way to spot issues early and cut repair costs. The site cites an average review rating of 4.6 stars. It also lists OEM and strategic partnerships.

quote.text: Proven smart fleet management technology for safety and efficiency.
